name: notice-board-visit-blocking-v1
description: ⭐ DOES A CLOGGING BOARD STALL THE GAME? THE CONTROL THAT MEASURES IT RATHER THAN ARGUING IT (Dean, 10/09/2026, S8 of docs/notice-board-visit-handoff-2026-09-10-v2.md). ONE LEAF CHANGES against overlays/notice-board-visit-v1.overlay.json and it is rules.economy.noticeBoardBlocks, false to TRUE: the Notice Board stops being the arm's `3+` board and becomes an ORDINARY CLOGGING BUILDING, full at rules.economy.noticeBoardThreshold and refusing every card until its owner spends a Harvest on it. Everything else is the arm, pinned leaf for leaf. THE RULE IT TAKES AWAY: S8 says the threshold is `3+` and the plus sign IS the rule - three is the MINIMUM before the owner may harvest, not a maximum load, cards can always be added, nothing ever blocks, and the owner alone chooses when to cash in. ⭐ THAT IS THE DELIBERATE DIFFERENCE FROM EVERY OTHER BUILDING IN THE GAME, and the reason for it is not symmetry but A DOCUMENTED FAILURE IN THE PREDECESSOR: the game stalls when nobody wants to load. A blocking board can be SHUT BY AN OWNER WHO DECLINES TO HARVEST, and an owner is paid nothing for shutting it, so the denial is free; at two players there are only two boards on the table and a shut one is total denial rather than a race. ⚠️ THE ENGINE SEAM THIS ARM EXERCISES IS NEW AND IS WHERE A BUG WOULD LIVE: under the arm, isFull and canTakeCard are SEPARATE QUESTIONS for the first time in this codebase - a board at five cards is harvestable AND still accepts cards - and under this control they collapse back into one. A caller that asks "is it full" when it means "may I place here" is wrong under the arm and right under this control, which is the worst way round, so a delta here that looks like design may be that seam instead. READ IT IN THIS ORDER: (1) a20, THE STALL - how often a board sits at or above its threshold unharvested and for how long, in both arms; the arm should show boards sitting fat and harvested late by choice, this control should show boards sitting SHUT and the traffic going elsewhere. (2) THE BLOCKED-WANT RATE AT TWO PLAYERS, which is the number the old v31 clog was read on and where this rule is at its most brutal. (3) THE VISIT SPREAD and the bonus rate on the turn measure: if the rate falls here, a blocking board is a structural gate on the bonus and every lesson this project has about structures applies - they ration hard and charge tempo. (4) GAME LENGTH, which is what a stall shows up in last and worst. (5) HARVEST TRAFFIC ON THE BOARD ITSELF: under the arm an owner harvests when the pile is worth it, under this control an owner harvests to REOPEN, which is a different action taken for a different reason and the door mix should say so. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors, reference-v15 seeds), paired against the arm on identical seeds. The engine's hand limit of 7 is the simulator's bound and not a rule of the game (C7). ⛔ PINNED AT dairyGrowsBuilt 'none' ON 12/09/2026, WHEN THE BASE MOVED TO 'paidWild'. Every number published off this arm was measured BEFORE Dean ruled the Dairy board's follow-on Grow in, so the pin is what keeps this file reproducing what it measured. A new arm that wants the ruled rule should say so by name. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⚠️ 13/09/2026: rules.economy.noticeBoardsBySeats.2 1 is pinned here because the shipped defaults flipped when the commons was deleted, so this arm stays the game it was.
